scope.later_update_review: Current accepted evidence/canonical update paths were checked during the 2026-10-07 review. No later accepted facility-status predicate was located that supersedes the rulings below.

public_state_definitions.RED: Inoperable base (whole). Apply only when the represented tracked facility/node itself is established destroyed or not operating.
public_state_definitions.YELLOW: Damaged; parts inoperable. Apply only when physical damage is established and at least one represented component is explicitly destroyed or inoperable; do not infer whole-facility shutdown.
public_state_definitions.BLUE: Damaged; operable. Requires physical damage plus affirmative evidence that the represented facility is operating at facility scope; presence or absence of shutdown reporting is insufficient.
public_state_definitions.GREEN: Untouched. Requires affirmative evidence sufficient to establish no strike/damage through the relevant conflict period plus operational continuity; absence of a damage report alone is insufficient.

temporal_rule: States below are the last verified evidence-supported condition and remain qualified by their stated effective/verification dates. The adjudication does not infer repair, reconstitution, continued shutdown, or continued degradation beyond accepted evidence.

classified.facility: Port Shuaiba U.S. tactical operations center
classified.basis: The represented tracked entity is the tactical operations center/outpost itself, and the accepted predicate classifies that specific node as DESTROYED. This ruling does not extend to Camp Arifjan or the wider regional network.
classified.qualification: RED is scoped only to the tracked Shuaiba TOC/outpost, not Port Shuaiba as a whole and not Camp Arifjan.

classified.facility: Naval Support Activity Bahrain / Fifth Fleet HQ area
classified.basis: Verified physical damage includes two radomes reported destroyed and a SATCOM dish hit; the Fifth Fleet headquarters function was relocated to MacDill. The accepted record explicitly rejects whole-installation cessation.
classified.qualification: YELLOW reflects confirmed destroyed/inoperable subcomponents and relocated HQ function; it does not imply the entire installation is inoperable.

classified.basis: Multiple missile strikes severely damaged the Combined Air Operations Center and the accepted record says the CAOC was rendered inoperable. The same record explicitly states that whole-base incapacity is not established.
classified.qualification: YELLOW is scoped to confirmed inoperable CAOC/subfacility effects. It is not a finding that Al Udeid as a whole stopped operating.

classified.basis: Accepted material-loss evidence states that Camp Arifjan communications equipment was destroyed and a radome was damaged or destroyed. Later troop presence is not upgraded to a BLUE whole-facility operating finding.
classified.qualification: YELLOW reflects confirmed destroyed communications equipment. Whole-site operating status remains unresolved.

unclassified_tracked.reason: Verified localized damage is established, but the accepted predicate does not affirm a current inoperable component at the required scope or affirmative whole-base operation.
Power-plant and other damage is verified, but current component inoperability and whole-site operation are not affirmatively established.
Iranian damage claim is not independently corroborated; presence does not establish operation and no damage state is established.

Port-area damage/fire is established, but U.S.-specific asset loss and whole access-site operational effect remain unresolved.
Damage is verified, but later posture is governed by a separate drawdown; current combat-damage operating state is not cleanly established.
U.S. forces withdrew before the war baseline. This is an administrative/withdrawn state, not one of the four combat-damage states.

THAAD/aircraft damage is established, but exact BDA and whole-base operational effect remain unresolved; do not infer partial inoperability beyond the accepted record.

Operational continuity is established, but the damage predicate is only NO_REPORTED_DAMAGE_FOUND. GREEN requires an affirmative untouched finding, and an accepted March 13 interception near Incirlik has an unresolved intended target. Do not convert absence of verified damage into GREEN.
Patriot/base damage is established, but whole-site operating effect and a specifically inoperable current component are not affirmatively established.
Drawdown/current-presence uncertainty is the controlling state. No verified war damage is not an affirmative GREEN finding.
Withdrawal began before/early in the war period. This is a drawdown state, not a four-color combat-damage state.
U.S. withdrawal completed before the war. This is a withdrawn state, not a four-color combat-damage state.

raf_akrotiri_note: Do not promote RAF Akrotiri from this proposal. It is not a tracked facility record in data/facilities.json, and the accepted reconciliation record currently says the March 1 Akrotiri missile item is CONTESTED_NOT_PINNED with conflicting UK/Cyprus accounts. The proposal's stronger damage assertion is therefore not adopted here.

renderer_handoff.rule: Renderer may color only records in classified. All unclassified tracked facilities must remain neutral/unclassified; do not synthesize BLUE or GREEN from presence, no-shutdown wording, or absence of damage reporting.
